description: An always-on engineering operating manual plus spec-workflow skills and templates. Org standards centralized so every product repo picks up changes via /plugin update.

github_pat.title: GitHub personal access token
github_pat.description: Fine-grained PAT for the bundled GitHub MCP server (repo + issues scope). Prompted once at install and stored in your OS keychain, so it never needs exporting from a shell rc and never lands in a repo file. Optional: leave it blank and the github server simply reports disconnected -- every skill that uses it falls back to the gh CLI, then to a manual floor.
